proof: R=norm(X) is Lipschitz and even. Its centered Hermite coefficients have only degrees>=2. Parseval for weak Gaussian derivatives gives sum k||P_kR||^2=E||grad R||^2=1. Therefore VarR<=1/2 and a_d=(d-VarR)/d>=1-1/(2d).
